allow: PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty TotalPhysicalMemory | ForEach-Object { "$\([math]::Round\($_ / 1GB, 1\)\) GB" })

PowerShell($pids = \(netstat -ano | findstr ":3001 " | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim\(\).Split\(\)[-1] } | Sort-Object -Unique\); foreach \($p in $pids\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; Write-Output "Done")
